notes.title: Dragon Ball Xenoverse DLC: GT PACK 1
notes.content:
Dragon Ball GT Pack 1 (DLC) for Dragon Ball Xenoverse is going to be released on March 17th for Steam.

This DLC Pack includes:
- 3 new playables characters (Kid Goku GT, Trunks GT and Pan)
- 1 new stage (Planet Tuffle)
- 5 new costumes, 3 new accessories, 9 new Z-souls
- 2 new Masters (Tien and Yamcha)
- 15 new special moves to be learned from Tien and Yamcha
- 4 Time Patrol Quests and 3 Parallel Quests

notes.title: Dragon Ball Xenoverse updated!
notes.content:
Hi dear Dragon Ball Xenoverse players, following your feedbacks we fixed some issues of the game. 
Please update your version now to enjoy the following fixes:

• The Z-Soul 'You can be the first victim' now works properly and gives full bars of Ki when activated. This issue tends to happen with 60 FPS framerate.

•The Z-Soul 'Tien, Please don’t die' now works properly and charge all allies' Ki to max when the player's character gets knocked out. This issue tends to happen with 60 FPS framerate.

•The Z-Soul 'I'll take you down!' now works properly and gives full bars of Ki when activated. This issue tends to happen with 60 FPS framerate.

•The Z-Soul 'Bwa ha ha… Thanks for the energy.' now behave properly and gives health based on the damage received when activated. 

Thanks for your everlasting support

notes.title: SERVER UPDATE
notes.content:
Attention Dragon Ball XENOVERSE players!
Toki Toki City has been overflowing with your custom characters during our first week of release and we’re very excited to share the Dragon Ball world with all of you! Some players have reported difficulties connecting to the Dragon Ball XENOVERSE servers to enjoy the online features of the game. 
We worked tirelessly to address the server issues so that everyone can have a smooth experience both on and offline and we are on the way to fix it!
So a server update will be pushed today (March 4th 2015) to apply the changes:
-	Japan - 20:30 PM to 00:30 AM JST
-	Europe - 12:30 to 16:30 CET
-	North America - 3:30 AM to 7:30 AM PST

We will continue to provide updates on the official Steam forums and the official Dragon Ball Games Facebook page to keep you updated.

If you are having issues connecting to the servers and wish to play completely offline, that is an option. Disabling your internet connection before starting the game will boot the game into Offline Mode. We understand that this is not an acceptable fix and will continue to provide updates on the Dragon Ball XENOVERSE server stability. 

Thank you for your patience!

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - DRAGON BALL XENOVERSE
notes.content:
DRAGON BALL XENOVERSE is Now Available on Steam!

DRAGON BALL XENOVERSE revisits famous battles from the series through your custom Avatar and other classic characters. New features include the mysterious Toki Toki City, new gameplay mechanics, new animations and many other amazing features!

notes.title: NEW CHARACTERS AND INFORMATION REVEALED FOR DRAGON BALL XENOVERSE!
notes.content:
New characters revealed, a Season Pass announced and more villainous characters unveiled: DRAGON BALL XENOVERSE keep on aiming higher than ever!

Omega Shenron and Gogeta SS4 confirmed to join DRAGON BALL XENOVERSE roster, isn't that great?!!!

The list of characters turned into villainous mode by Mira and Towa just got longer as Gotenks, Vegeta, Gohan, Piccolo, Androids and even the Great Apes are now confirmed! The two foes took their mischiefs even further by making Vegeta join the Ginyu Army…

You want more? Good because we are happy to announce a super-charged Season Pass is containing 3 different amazing DLC Packs for all Dragon Ball fans wishing to extend their experience. Here is a preview of the content:

DLC Pack 1 (Available in March 2015): 3 playable characters: GT Goku, Pan & GT Trunks; 4 Time Patrol quests; 12 Quests; 15 New Special Moves for the players’ avatars; 5 new costumes

DLC Pack 2 (release date to be confirmed later): Exclusive Playable Characters, Quests, Special moves and costumes

DLC Pack 3 (release date to be confirmed later): Turtle Hermit set, Jaco the Space Patroller and highly exclusive content!

DRAGON BALL XENOVERSE will be available for PlayStation 4, Xbox One, PlayStation 3, Xbox 360 and STEAM on February 27th.
